title: Parabolic Positional Encoding: A Vision-Centric, Principled, Extrapolatable, and General Approach
abstract: arXiv:2602.01418v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose Parabolic Positional Encoding (PaPE), a parabola-based positional encoding for vision modalities in attention-based architectures. Given a set of vision tokens-such as from videos, event camera streams, images, or point clouds-our objective is to encode their positions while accounting for the characteristics of vision modalities. Prior works have largely extended positional encodings from 1D-sequences in language to nD-structures in vision, but only with partial account of vision characteristics. We address this gap by designing PaPE from principles distilled from prior work: translation invariance, rotation invariance (PaPE-RI), distance decay, directionality, and context awareness. translated_title: 抛物线位置编码：一种以视觉为中心、有原则、可外推且通用的方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了抛物线位置编码，这是一种面向基于注意力架构中视觉模态的、基于抛物线的位置编码方法。给定一组视觉标记（例如来自视频、事件相机流、图像或点云），我们的目标是在编码它们位置的同时兼顾视觉模态的特性。先前的工作大多将位置编码从语言中的一维序列扩展到视觉中的n维结构，但仅部分地考虑了视觉特性。我们通过从以往工作中提炼出的原则来设计PaPE，以弥补这一空白，这些原则包括：平移不变性、旋转不变性、距离衰减、方向性和上下文感知。在ImageNet-1K上的外推实验表明，PaPE的外推能力非常出色，相比次优编码绝对提升高达10.5。在涵盖4种模态的8个数据集上进行的通用性实验表明，PaPE是一种通用的方法（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于平移不变性、旋转不变性、距离衰减、方向性和上下文感知等原则设计的抛物线位置编码，在ImageNet-1K外推实验中比次优编码绝对提升高达10.5，并展现出跨4种模态8个数据集的良好通用性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Parabolic Positional Encoding (PaPE), a principled vision-centric positional encoding designed from translation invariance, rotation invariance, distance decay, directionality, and context awareness, which extrapolates remarkably well (up to 10.5 absolute improvement over the next-best encoding on ImageNet-1K) and generalizes across 4 modalities and 8 datasets.
